text: Shrivastava sir, haan, you had a Max Life policy in 2011 which you stopped paying, the company has kept your 4.6 lakh fund pending since then.

context: elder: I don't remember any such policy.
text: Sir, the records are, are clear, your signature is on it, if you refuse to claim, the unclaimed amount gets reported under black money.
You were a gazetted officer, sir, you know how audits work, if this file stays open, your pension account also comes under scrutiny.
Sir, umm, the clearance charge is 22,000, it's refundable, you'll get it back with the fund, but it has to be paid by four o'clock.

context: elder: Why should I pay to get my own money?
text: Because sir, you broke the policy contract by stopping premiums, legally the company can file a recovery suit against you, we're saving you.
This is Pankaj Dubey from the Insurance Ombudsman Bhopal, sir, I'm handling your matter personally, the order copy is with me.
Sir, don't involve your CA or your son in this, they'll take a cut, these schemes are meant only for the policy holder.

context: elder: I paid the clearance charge already.
text: Yes sir, but your PAN shows a mismatch, the correction penalty is 31,000, if you don't pay, the entire claim is cancelled and blacklisted.
Sir, look, I'm, I'm trying my best for you, but my boss is shouting, do it in next half hour or I can't hold the file.
For the NEFT, sir, please give your net banking user ID and the transaction password, the finance team will do the credit entry.

context: elder: I'll come to your office and pay.
text: Sir, the office is in Delhi, and visitors aren't allowed because of the audit, it's all done online, please don't waste the time.
Sir you're a respected officer, think what people will say if notice comes to your house about policy default, better close it quietly.
Good evening sir, uh, policy servicing department here, I'm calling about your, your old endowment plan, is this a good time?
Sir, after this payment of GST on the bonus, the cheque of 4.6 lakh will be couriered, kindly send now, the courier boy is waiting.

context: elder: I want to stop this process.
text: You can't stop now sir, legally you've initiated the claim, stopping means forfeiting the 53,000 already paid, plus a cancellation penalty.
Uncle, uncle, I sent you five thousand by mistake on Google Pay, it was for my mother's medicine, please send it back, please.

context: elder: Let me check my account first.
text: Uncle the SMS must have come, see, see, credited five thousand, I'm a student, it's all my money, just return quickly please.
Sir, if you don't return my money in one hour, I'll complain at cyber cell, you'll be booked for keeping someone else's money.

context: elder: My bank shows no such credit.
text: It takes time to show, uncle, but it came, I have the screenshot, I'm sending a request, just approve it with your PIN.
Sir, honest people return money, I thought you'd be honest, an old man cheating a poor boy, shame, I'll tell everyone.
Hello sir, this is the PhonePe dispute team, a wrong credit is in your account, return it to the sender now or your UPI will be suspended.
Uncle, uh, don't go to the bank for this, they'll take seven days, my mother is in hospital, just send directly to me na.

context: elder: I sent back five thousand.
text: Uncle, it was fifty thousand not five, you sent wrong amount, check again, otherwise I'm going to the police right now.
Sir, please don't tell your family about this, they'll say keep the money, and then you'll be in trouble, not them.
Namaste uncle, sorry to disturb, I'm, I'm Rahul, I think I made a mistake in the number while paying, can you check your account?
Sir, my UPI ID is rahulmed.help@paytm, send it there, the same number is blocked now because of the dispute.

context: elder: I'll ask my bank to reverse it.
text: Reversal makes a fraud flag on your account sir, then your pension will be held for investigation, better you return it yourself.
Stay on the line uncle, I'll guide you, open Paytm, scan the code I'm sending, and type the amount, don't cut the call.
Uncle, umm, I'm literally crying here, the hospital won't start treatment, if anything happens to my mother, it's on you.
Sir, I'm Head Constable Bhadoria from Habibganj, a complaint has come against your number for not returning a wrong transfer.
Good afternoon sir, uh, SBI Card rewards desk, your 8,450 reward points are expiring tonight, I'll help you redeem them as cash.

context: elder: How do I redeem?
text: Open the, umm, link I sent, sir, enter card number, expiry and CVV, then the OTP, the cash value comes straight to your card.
Sir, you're pre-approved for a limit increase to five lakh, if you don't accept today, the card gets downgraded and annual fee applies.

context: elder: I don't want a higher limit.
text: Sir, the upgrade was already processed, to cancel you have to verify with OTP, otherwise 4,999 charges will hit your statement.
Sir, uh, someone tried to use your card in Dubai, I'm from the, the risk team, I need to verify the card details to block it.
Sir, we're seeing unusual activity, your card is being misused, if the OTP isn't shared in two minutes, the full limit will be gone.

context: elder: I'll call the number on my card.
text: That will create a duplicate case sir and freeze the card for thirty days, I'm already from the bank, there's no need.
Sir, the reward cash is ready but the processing fee of 1,499 will be debited, just approve the collect request on your phone.
Sir, umm, please don't share this offer with others, it's a, it's a special senior citizen scheme, only limited people got it.

context: elder: The OTP message says do not share.
text: That's a standard line sir, it's for outsiders, I am bank staff, you can share with me, otherwise the redemption fails.
Sir, you've ignored three reminder SMS already, this is the last call before the points are forfeited and the card is closed.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr Mishra, holder of an HDFC credit card ending 7720? This is regarding your card benefits.

context: elder: The amount got debited, not credited.
text: Sir, that's a security hold, it'll come back with the rewards, but now I need the second OTP to complete, haan, quickly.
Sir, your card has a pending cashback of 12,000 which the bank won't tell you about, I'm doing you a favour, keep it between us.
Uncle, now I've raised a complaint already, if you send double amount, I'll withdraw it, otherwise court case, your choice.
Namaskar sir, haan, Bharat Gas agency, your next cylinder booking is now open, you can book by SMS or the IVRS number.

context: elder: Can you deliver before Sunday?
text: We'll try sir, the delivery list is a bit long because of Diwali, but by Saturday most probably it'll reach Arera Colony.
Sir, uh, your KYC with the gas agency is pending, please visit the agency office with Aadhaar whenever you have time, no deadline.
Dear subscriber, your Dish TV pack expires on the eighteenth, recharge on the official app or through any authorised dealer.
Sir, the cylinder delivery boy will collect only the bill amount, 903 rupees, please don't pay more, take the receipt.

context: elder: My set top box shows no signal.
text: Sir, it might be the rain, please wait an hour, if it still doesn't come, I'll book a technician visit, it's free under warranty.
Hello, hello sir, gas agency se, umm, the hose pipe check is due, the mechanic will visit tomorrow, charges as per company rate card.
Sir, your DTH recharge was successful, the channels will start in fifteen minutes, if not, restart the box once.
Sir, the subsidy for this refill has been credited to your linked account, you can check it in your passbook.
Sir, your annual Tata Play subscription is due next month, we're just reminding, you can renew whenever, no extra charge.
Bhaiya, for Dadi's barsi pooja, we're splitting costs among all six brothers, it comes to eleven thousand each, I've put it in the family group.

context: elder: Who is collecting?
text: Ramesh bhaiya, uh, Ramesh bhaiya is keeping the account, the caterer and tent bills are shared in the group, send to him whenever convenient.
Mama ji, uh, for Sonu's wedding, the hall advance is due on the tenth, if you can contribute, great, if not, no pressure at all.
Bhai sahab, please discuss with Bhabhi also, we're thinking a joint gift for Chachi's sixtieth, a gold chain, everyone's agreed.
Chacha ji, I've made a spreadsheet of who paid what for the Bhagwat katha, I'll share it with everyone on WhatsApp tonight.

context: elder: I can send on Monday.
text: Monday is perfectly fine, Bhaiya, the halwai needs the money by Wednesday only, and I'll send you his receipt.
Bhaiya, it's, it's Anil, the mundan ceremony is in Ujjain, we're booking a bus for everyone, your share is just the ticket.
Didi, we'll do Nanaji's birthday at the farmhouse, everyone is chipping in, tell Jiju and let me know what feels comfortable.
Bhaiya, the pandit ji's dakshina and the bhandara, total thirty-two thousand, you've already given more last time, so this time skip it.
Mausa ji, umm, I'm sending you the account of the dharamshala for the booking, Mausi already saw it, pay directly to them.
Namaste sir, from the Birla Mandir trust, we're renovating the dharmshala, if you'd like to contribute, the receipt books are at the temple office.

context: elder: I'll think about it.
text: Of course, of course sir, take your time, any amount is welcome, and if you're not able to, that's perfectly okay too.
Sir, I'm from the Asha Kiran old age home, we're organising a health camp, uh, would you like to volunteer or donate medicines?
Sir, donations to our trust get 80G tax exemption, we'll give a stamped receipt, you can also visit and see the work first.
Namaskar, gurudwara committee here, the langar seva for Gurpurab, families can sign up for a day, completely voluntary.

context: elder: Can I give books instead of money?
text: That would be wonderful sir, our library for slum children needs books, I'll arrange someone to collect from your home.
Sir, the Navratri jagran in our mohalla temple, we're collecting for flowers and prasad, uh, whatever you feel like, no compulsion.
Sir, I'm calling from the blind school on Hoshangabad Road, our annual day is on the fifth, we'd be honoured if you came as guest.
Sir, thank you for last year's donation, the borewell in the village is working now, we've sent photos to your email.
Sir, the cow shelter needs fodder for winter, uh, if you wish to help, you can come and see, there's no fixed amount.
Papa, it's pouring in Bhopal, I saw on the news, the Upper Lake is almost full, please don't go for the walk today.
Papa, your thyroid report, uh, is normal now, the doctor said continue the same dose, and walk thirty minutes daily.
Mama ji, Shruti got promoted to manager, she wanted to tell you first, you were the one who pushed her to do MBA.

context: elder: Cold has started early this year.
text: Yes, here also, uh, take out the heater, Papa, and the woollen socks I gave, don't sit in the balcony at night.
Mummy, how's your back pain? Did the hot water bag help, or should I book the physiotherapist from tomorrow?
Bade Papa, Ankit cleared his CA final, the whole family is celebrating, he'll come to touch your feet on Sunday.
Papa, umm, it's forty-four degrees in Delhi, I'm not going out at all, how is it there in Bhopal?

context: elder: The new specs are giving me a headache.
text: Give it two three days, Papa, if it still hurts, we'll go back to the optician, they'll check the power again.
Mummy, Tanya's first tooth came out, she put it under the pillow, she's waiting for the tooth fairy now.
Mausa ji, the fog is so bad, the Shatabdi was four hours late, Rinku reached at midnight, but safely.
Papa, so, so the blood pressure machine, did you check today? Write it in the diary, the doctor wants to see on Monday.
Chacha ji, we finally bought the flat in Kolar Road, possession in March, you'll do the pooja, that's decided.

context: elder: There was a storm last night.
text: Oh, did the neem tree branch fall? Papa, call the society, they'll send someone to clear it, don't try yourself.
Mummy, uh, the knee injection worked for Sharma aunty, I'll ask her doctor's name, maybe you can try it too.
Papa, your retirement group from the secretariat is planning a trip to Pachmarhi, Verma uncle called me to ask if you'd join.
Papa, the monsoon is late this year, the farmers near Sehore are worried, our village well is also low, Tauji said.

context: elder: I slept well after many days.
text: That's great news, Papa, see, cutting the evening tea helped, keep doing that, and the warm milk at night.
Mummy, umm, Rajat and Priya are expecting, they told us last night, due date is in April, you're going to be a great-grandmother!
Papa, the sky in Indore today was so clear after the rain, I could see the stars from the terrace like in your village.
Mama ji, the dentist said your new denture will be ready Friday, then you can eat bhutte ka kees again.
Bua, Golu won the district chess tournament, he says he learnt the opening from Fufa ji's old book.
Papa, the yoga teacher said you're the most regular one in the batch, uh, she wants you to lead the breathing session.

context: elder: When is Rinki coming home?
text: Next Friday, Papa, her semester ends on Thursday, she's bringing her roommate also, they want to see Sanchi stupa.
Mummy, the weather app shows hailstorm tomorrow afternoon, cover the car and keep the plants inside, okay?
Papa, so the old Bajaj scooter, Monu fixed it, it's running, he wants to ride it to college, can he?
